before: The private column planner carried structural commands but lacked row-anchored rich new-cell content and deferred explicit widths.
after: A pure insert-column intent carries canonical anchors, per-row new fragments, complete payload bindings, and an optional explicit width. Native previews validate destinations, merges, continuations, and fixed-grid sizing. Row and column plans share bounded fragment and payload validation.
reason: Planning changes no live package or shared format. Allocated native IDs stay outside serialized plans. A test-only immutable oracle verifies insertion and save/reopen. A01/R09 retain actual transactions, review, and rich-column two-session verification. No publishable package code changes.
